import 'dart:io';

import 'package:hazard_fixture/shout.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  // Both sides are the code under test, one of them in another process.
  test('the program says what the function says', () {
    final program = Process.runSync(Platform.resolvedExecutable, [
      'bin/shout.dart',
      'word',
    ]);
    expect((program.stdout as String).trim(), shout('word'));
  });

  test('width', () => expect(width('ab'), 4));
}
